title: Brucie: The Reluctant Buckaroo Who Built a Monster
body: Ramon almost didn't sign up for the Buckaroo Football League at all, and for a while the standings suggested he'd been right to hesitate. His Araleasers debuted in 2023 with a 4-10 record, 1,375.3 points, and the 6 seed, then finished fifth of six. Only Sonny's Ben Dover kept Brucie off the bottom. He made just 2 pickups and zero trades that year, which is less a waiver strategy than a witness protection program.

2024 is when the turncoat Bills fan from Chicago turned into a problem. The Araleasers went 7-7, grabbed the 3 seed, and rode a playoff win all the way to Buckaroo Bowl II, where Kaushal's Habibsters were waiting to collect their second straight ring. Second place on 1 pickup and 0 trades remains one of the league's great low-effort heists. It was also the year of his worst week ever, a 56.4-point dud against, of course, Habib.

Then came 2025, a season that lives forever with an asterisk. Ramon ran the Araleasers through week 8 and was kicked from the league for inactivity. The orphaned roster, renamed Ramon's Remains, opened the post-Brucie era with a 94.76-92.02 win over Alan and went on a run that still makes the group chat cackle. The team posted a career-high 1,523.7 points, 4 trades, and 8 pickups on the year, and finished 5-11 and fifth of six. Every one of those games counts on Ramon's record, which means he is the only manager whose team might have played better with him gone.

The head-to-head ledger reads like a list of grudges. Kaushal owns him at 8-4, and Randy (7-4) and Sonny (7-5) have also had his number. Alan sits at 6-5 against him in a battle of the league's two favorite villains. Mekhi is his punching bag at 6-3. He's also 1-0 against rookie Zoe, so welcome to the league, Zilgit.

Which brings us to 2026, and the part that drives everyone crazy. No Banner only HULK is 5-1 with 829.4 points and a 50 percent shot at the title. It opened the year with a 177.9-point demolition of Kai, the best week of Brucie's career. After a mostly hands-off history, he's even working the phones, with 1 trade and 4 pickups so far. The guy who wasn't sure he wanted in now has the best team in the league, and seven managers are rooting for the controller to go flying.
